$comment: Catalog of viral short-form formats → future reelclaw templates. Generated from research by Engineer #9; see catalog/TAXONOMY.md (field meanings) and catalog/PRIMITIVES_GAP.md (what to build next). Edit by hand; keep ids unique.

video.description: video clip: trim, loop, box, fit, crop, mirror (timeline.video)

clip_audio.description: keep a clip's own sound at a volume (video volume / timeline.audio)

caption.description: static auto-fit caption, tiktok-outline / tiktok-box / plain styles

karaoke.description: word-by-word captions from word timings, spoken word highlighted (karaokeCaptions component)

motion.description: GSAP tweens of x/y/scale/rotation/opacity on a clip

cutout.description: AI background removal in prepare() (hyperframes remove-background + media.derive)

html.description: html() escape hatch for one-off motion graphics

caption_track.description: timed caption list from a script ('text :: secs' / 'text :: 10-15'), sequential or absolute; generalises no-yapping steps

sequence.description: N clips/photos back-to-back as hard cuts, cycled and continued (sequence / evenCuts / slotBounds components)

transcribe.description: word timestamps from a clip (transcribeMedia via hyperframes transcribe, or loadTranscript for JSON/SRT/VTT), cached

slideshow.description: image/clip slides with per-slide duration, Ken Burns pan/zoom and per-slide text

beat_sync.description: beat times from the music (detectBeats via hyperframes beats, cached) + snapToBeats for cuts

rank_badges.description: numbered list badges (numberBadge component); titles via caption()

chat_ui.description: iMessage / WhatsApp / DM chat bubbles appearing over time

social_card.description: tweet / Reddit post / review / App Store review card overlay

notification_ui.description: lock-screen push notifications / widgets stacking in

search_ui.description: search bar with typed query (Google / TikTok / App Store)

phone_frame.description: device frame around a screen recording (static or tilted)

typewriter.description: character/word reveal for text that is meant to be read while typing (exception to static captions)

counter.description: animated number / money / day counter, progress bar, timer

wipe.description: before/after wipe reveal with a divider bar (wipeReveal component)

blur_fill.description: landscape/square footage shown whole over a blurred copy of itself (visual component, fill auto/blur)

jump_cut.description: tighten pauses in talking-head footage from word timings (speechRanges / layoutSegments)

zoom_punch.description: punch-in zoom / shake on emphasis words or beats (preset over motion)

speed.description: speed ramps, timelapse, slow-mo, reverse, freeze-frame

tts.description: text-to-speech voiceover (hyperframes tts) cached in prepare()

sfx.description: bundled royalty-free SFX (pop, whoosh, ding, shutter, keyboard)

emoji.description: colour emoji / sticker overlays (bundled emoji font, OFL)

annotate.description: arrows, circles, highlights, X marks, redaction blur at a box over time

end_card.description: CTA end card / persistent banner: app icon, name, store badge, offer, handle

filters.description: per-clip colour treatment: grayscale, VHS, film grain, warm/cool grade

chroma_key.description: key out a solid-colour background in supplied green-screen footage

duck.description: duck music under voice segments automatically

poll_ui.description: poll / quiz / this-or-that UI with result reveal

transitions.description: flash / whip / zoom transitions between clips (most formats hard-cut)

lower_third.description: name tag / chyron / news-style lower third

formats.name: Reaction → Demo
formats.description: Creator reacts for ~3s under a hook caption, hard cut to the app screen recording that answers the hook. The workhorse app-growth format.
structure: 0-3s: creator reaction clip, hook caption in safe band
3s-end: hard cut to full-screen demo recording, optional payoff caption

example_reference.description: Original reelclaw v1 template; DanSUGC 'Face Reaction' concept family (5.9M avg views across 6 concepts).

formats.name: Reaction over Demo (split)
formats.description: Reaction stays on screen in the top half while the demo plays in the bottom half, so the emotion and the proof are visible together.

example_reference.description: Split-screen reaction is one of the most-cited 2026 TikTok formats (eliro.pro format guide).

formats.name: Demo with Reaction PiP
formats.description: Full-screen demo with the creator's reaction in a corner picture-in-picture bubble; works when the demo itself is the hook.
structure: reaction in a bottom-right PiP inside the safe zone
hook caption top of band, payoff at the end

example_reference.description: Common UGC overlay pattern ('UGC Overlay' in Motion's ad format library).

formats.name: Shocked → Reveal
formats.description: A big shocked/surprised face over 'when I found out…' text, then a reveal of the screenshot/result that caused it.
structure: 1.5-4s: screenshot or result image with zoom-in
4s-end: demo / result held with payoff caption

example_reference.description: DanSUGC tracked viral concept (reelclaw_suggest_formats, Oct 2026): 'Shocked Reaction', ~18M views.

formats.name: Laptop Reaction
formats.description: Creator stares at a laptop then reacts to what's on it; cut to the screen. Native for SaaS/AI tools and study apps.
structure: 0-2.5s: creator at laptop reacting, hook caption
2.5s-end: screen recording of the laptop screen (blur-filled if landscape)

example_reference.description: DanSUGC tracked viral concept (reelclaw_suggest_formats, Oct 2026): 'Laptop Reaction', ~4.1M views, ~1748x outlier.

formats.name: Surprised (Self-care) Reaction
formats.description: Creator mid-routine (skincare, hair) turns to camera surprised; caption carries the twist, cut to the product/app.

example_reference.description: DanSUGC tracked viral concept (reelclaw_suggest_formats, Oct 2026): 'Surprised', ~11M views.

formats.name: Head-shake → Nod
formats.description: Creator shakes head 'no' at the old way/competitor, then nods 'yes' at your product. Two-beat contrast that reads with sound off.

example_reference.description: DanSUGC tracked viral concept (reelclaw_suggest_formats, Oct 2026): 'Negative', ~6.1M views.

formats.name: Double Reaction Escalation
formats.description: Two reactions that escalate (mild → losing it) before the reveal; the second beat resets attention at ~2s.

example_reference.description: Pattern seen across face-reaction hooks: stacked reactions before the payoff.

formats.name: Looks at Phone → Screen
formats.description: Creator looks down at their phone and reacts; cut to the phone screen (screenshot or recording) with a slow push-in.
structure: 0-2s: creator looking at phone, reaction + hook
2s-end: phone screen full-bleed with push-in, payoff caption

example_reference.description: Standard app-promo hook; 'Relationship outcome' and widget apps use it (Lightreel Oct 2026 report).

formats.name: Reaction → Stat
formats.description: Reaction under 'I can't believe this worked', then a big counting-up number (money saved, streak, followers) and the screen that proves it.
structure: 2-4s: large animated counter on solid/blurred bg

example_reference.description: Numeric-payoff hooks (Lightreel: 'Numeric pain point', debt-payoff results).

formats.name: Crying Reaction + Text
formats.description: Emotional crying/overwhelmed reaction under a wall-of-text story, resolving with the product as the turning point.
structure: 4s-end: calm proof shot / demo with resolution caption

example_reference.description: DanSUGC tracked viral concept (reelclaw_suggest_formats, Oct 2026): 'Hysterical crying', ~0.9M views, 177x outlier.

formats.name: Comment → Reaction → Demo
formats.description: Starts with a TikTok-style comment-reply sticker ('does this actually work?'), creator reacts, then shows the demo answering it.
structure: 0-3s: reaction with comment-reply sticker top of band

example_reference.description: 'Comment Response' and reply-to-comment are top native formats (Motion library).

formats.name: Arms-Up Win
formats.description: Creator throws arms up celebrating, caption states the win; cut to the screen that shows it (grade, payout, streak).

example_reference.description: DanSUGC tracked viral concept (reelclaw_suggest_formats, Oct 2026): 'Arms up', 29x outlier.

formats.name: Reaction Loop
formats.description: Reaction → demo → the same reaction again so the video loops seamlessly and gets rewatched.
structure: last 1s: first frames of the reaction again (seam)

example_reference.description: Loop-bait editing; rewatch rate is a ranking signal on TikTok.

formats.name: Greenscreen Reaction
formats.description: Creator cut-out (AI background removal) over the demo, dragged from the centre into a corner as the demo starts. Native audio on.
structure: 0-2s: creator cut-out large over the demo, talking
2-3s: cut-out animates into a bottom corner
3s-end: demo full screen, creator cut-out in corner

formats.name: Greenscreen over Screenshot
formats.description: Creator cut-out in the lower third talking over a screenshot (article, tweet, app screen) as the background.
structure: 0-end: screenshot background (Ken Burns), creator cut-out bottom

example_reference.description: TikTok green-screen effect format; eliro.pro: 'show your source' commentary.

formats.name: Greenscreen Tweet Takedown
formats.description: Creator reacts/argues in front of a rendered tweet or Reddit post card; card text is input, no screenshot needed.

formats.name: Greenscreen App Walkthrough
formats.description: Creator cut-out beside a scrolling app recording, pointing at features; arrows/circles highlight what they mention.

example_reference.description: Creator explainer pattern for SaaS/AI apps.

formats.name: Greenscreen Website Scroll
formats.description: Creator over a long website/landing-page scroll; 'this website feels illegal to know' style.
structure: 2s-end: page scroll background (image pan or recording)

example_reference.description: 'Underrated websites' genre; 'Website Mockup' in Motion's library.

formats.name: Greenscreen Stats Explainer
formats.description: Creator explains a statistic shown as a big animated number or simple chart behind them.

formats.name: Greenscreen News Reaction
formats.description: Creator reacts to a headline card (news-style) for a trend or launch; jacks into news cycles.

formats.name: Greenscreen Photo Commentary
formats.description: Creator narrates over a sequence of photos that change per point (e.g. rating someone's setup, room, outfit).

formats.name: Greenscreen Competitor Teardown
formats.description: Creator over competitor screenshots, slapping X marks / one-word verdicts, ending on your app with a check mark.

formats.name: Real Green-Screen Footage
formats.description: Same as greenscreen formats but with footage shot on a real green/blue screen: chroma-key instead of AI matting (faster, cleaner hair).

example_reference.description: Studio/UGC creators who shoot on green screens.

formats.name: …but No Yapping
formats.description: Mouth-taped intro hook, then split screen: creator typing on top, screen recording below, step captions on the seam. Silence is the format.
structure: step captions on the seam, last holds

example_reference.description: Original reelclaw v1 template ('making $10k but no yapping').

formats.name: Tutorial Speed-Run
formats.description: 3-7 steps in 30-60s with numbered on-screen labels and a clear completion moment.

formats.name: How-To Screen Recording
formats.description: Single screen recording with step captions changing at timestamps and zoom-ins on the tapped area.

formats.name: Hack You Didn't Know
formats.description: 'iPhone/app hack nobody talks about' hook over a reaction, then the 5-10s screen proof.

formats.name: The Prompt That…
formats.description: 'The ChatGPT prompt that got me X' — prompt typed in an AI chat mockup, answer streams in, result shown.
structure: 2-8s: AI chat mockup, prompt typing, answer streaming

example_reference.description: AI-tool tutorials; 'ChatGPT' format in Motion's library.

formats.name: Settings You Should Change
formats.description: Numbered list of settings, each a short screen-recording clip zoomed onto the toggle.
structure: per item 3-4s: recording + number badge + setting name

formats.name: Tap-Zoom Walkthrough
formats.description: Screen recording that auto-zooms to each tap with a cursor/tap ripple, like polished product tours.
structure: 0-end: recording with zoom keyframes per tap

formats.name: Do This, Not That
formats.description: Split screen: wrong way (red X) top vs right way (green check) bottom, repeated for 2-4 tips.
structure: per tip: top 'don't' clip + X, bottom 'do' clip + check

formats.name: Study/Work-With-Me Timelapse
formats.description: Timelapse of a work session with a ticking timer and task checklist; app shown as the timer/to-do.
structure: 2s-end: sped-up footage + counter timer + checklist items ticking

formats.name: My Workflow in 60s
formats.description: Rapid tour of a creator's tool stack: each tool a 3-5s clip with name badge and one-line why.
structure: per tool: clip + tool-name badge + why caption

formats.name: Code Snippet Typing
formats.description: Code typed out in an editor-style panel over b-roll or face, ending with the output.

formats.name: Shortcut Tips
formats.description: Key-cap overlays appear while the screen shows the effect; numbered list of shortcuts.
structure: per shortcut: recording + key-cap graphic + label

formats.name: Tool Recipe
formats.description: Recipe framing for software: 'ingredients' (tools) list card, then numbered steps, then the finished dish (result).

formats.name: Talking Tutorial Split
formats.description: Creator explains on top half (with voice + karaoke), screen recording on the bottom half in sync.
structure: 0-end: split — face top with karaoke, recording bottom

formats.name: Wall of Text
formats.description: A long first-person story caption covering most of the safe band over a single looping clip; the reader stays to finish reading.
structure: wall-of-text caption auto-fit in the band

example_reference.description: Ubiquitous storytime/text format; 'Text Overlay' and 'Storytelling with text overlay' (eliro).

formats.name: POV Text Hook
formats.description: 'POV: you finally…' one-line caption over b-roll acting it out, with an optional second beat revealing the app.

example_reference.description: POV is a core 2026 TikTok format (eliro, contentgrip).

formats.name: Stacked Reveals Story
formats.description: Story told in short caption beats that replace each other every 2-3s over one clip, each adding new information.

example_reference.description: 'Stacked information reveals' used by text-story publishers (Lightreel).

formats.name: Text Message Story
formats.description: Fake-conversation drama told through iMessage bubbles appearing one by one over gameplay or b-roll.

formats.name: AI Reply Text Story
formats.description: Chat drama where the app suggests the perfect reply mid-conversation (Rizz-style native insertion).

formats.name: Reddit Story over Gameplay
formats.description: TTS voice reads a Reddit-style post (card at top), satisfying gameplay below; karaoke captions centre.
structure: 3s-end: gameplay full/bottom, karaoke captions of TTS

formats.name: Notes App Confession
formats.description: A Notes-app page with a confession/list; text scrolls or fills, ending with the app as the fix.
structure: 0-end: notes UI full screen or over blurred b-roll

formats.name: Things I Wish I Knew
formats.description: 'Things I wish I knew before…' numbered wall-of-text points over aesthetic b-roll cuts.
structure: per point 3-4s: new b-roll + numbered caption

formats.name: Unpopular Opinion
formats.description: Creator stares at camera under a bold opinion caption; second caption delivers the reason/product.

formats.name: Day N of Using X
formats.description: Diary series: 'day 12 of using X until I Y' over the day's b-roll, with a counter of progress.

example_reference.description: Episodic series formats perform well in 2026 (contentgrip).

formats.name: Letter / Personal Note
formats.description: A handwritten-looking letter ('dear future me', 'to the girl who…') filling the screen, slow scroll.
structure: 0-end: letter card on paper texture, slow pan

example_reference.description: 'Letter' format: ~1.7x spend ratio in Motion's 2026 library.

formats.name: Tell Me Without Telling Me
formats.description: Prompt caption 'tell me you X without telling me', answer is a single visual (screen/b-roll).

formats.name: Search Bar Story
formats.description: Story told through search queries typed one after another ('how to stop…', 'is it normal to…'), ending on the app.
structure: each 2s: search bar typing a query

formats.name: Lock-Screen Notification Story
formats.description: Narrative told by push notifications stacking on a lock screen (missed calls, texts, app alerts).

formats.name: Post-It Note
formats.description: Sticky-note graphic with handwritten-style text over a product or b-roll shot.

formats.name: Cliffhanger + Search Code
formats.description: Narrative clip cut at the peak with a persistent 'search code / continue in app' banner.

formats.name: I Asked AI…
formats.description: 'I asked ChatGPT to…' question in an AI chat UI, answer streams, reaction to the answer.

formats.name: Group Chat Drama
formats.description: Group chat with multiple named participants, coloured bubbles, read receipts.

formats.name: Emotion Before Product
formats.description: Pure emotional statement over moody b-roll ('a week away from you feels…'), app named only in the last caption — no UI shown.

formats.name: Don't Download This
formats.description: 'Do NOT download this app if…' list of reasons that are actually benefits.

formats.name: Countdown Story
formats.description: 'X days until…' with a day counter and a short daily caption over b-roll.

formats.name: Listicle
formats.description: Hook title then N items, each a clip with a numbered label and one-line caption; title persists.

example_reference.description: 'Listicle' is a top-10 hit-rate ad format (Motion 2026).

formats.name: Top 5 Countdown
formats.description: Countdown from 5 to 1, more time on #1; your product sits at #1.

formats.name: Tier List
formats.description: S/A/B/C/D tier grid fills in as items are dragged in; creator voice-over or captions.
structure: 0-end: tier board, items animate into rows

formats.name: Rating Apps in One Word
formats.description: Rival apps each get a one-word brutal verdict ('ghosted', 'hookups'); your app gets the good one.

formats.name: Apps That Feel Illegal to Know
formats.description: Rapid list of apps/websites, each a screen recording with name badge; yours placed 2nd or last.

formats.name: Red Flags / Green Flags
formats.description: Items labelled with red or green flag emoji; product is the green flag.
structure: per item: clip + flag emoji + caption

formats.name: N Things AI Can Do Now
formats.description: Numbered list of AI capabilities with short result clips.

formats.name: Trending Checklist Embed
formats.description: Aesthetic checklist ('fall reset', 'that girl routine') where the app is just one of the items.
structure: checklist card; each item checks off with b-roll

example_reference.description: Retro: app buried as one item in a checklist (Lightreel).

formats.name: Habits That Changed My Life
formats.description: Numbered habits over routine b-roll; one habit is using the app.

formats.name: This or That
formats.description: Two options side by side, viewer picks; 'pick one' poll UI with percentages.
structure: per round: left/right options + poll bar

example_reference.description: Interactive formats (polls/quizzes) cited for completion lift (2026 trend reports).

formats.name: Worth It / Not Worth It
formats.description: Purchases/subscriptions rated worth it or not with stamp overlays.

formats.name: Starter Pack
formats.description: Grid of images with labels forming a 'X starter pack'; your app is one tile.

formats.name: Signs You're a…
formats.description: 'Signs you're a [persona]' numbered relatable items, final sign is using the app.

formats.name: Underrated Websites
formats.description: Each website: URL badge + 3s scroll recording.

formats.name: Products Under $X
formats.description: Items with price tags, ending with the cheapest/best (your product).

formats.name: 3 Tips + 1 Secret
formats.description: Three known tips quickly, then a 'secret' fourth that is the product, with a held beat before it.

formats.name: Talking Head + Captions
formats.description: Creator to camera with auto word-by-word captions and a hook title for the first seconds. The base of all spoken formats.
structure: 0-end: face + karaoke captions centre-low of band

example_reference.description: Word-by-word captions are the top caption style for spoken short-form in 2026 (caption studies).

formats.name: Jump-Cut Talking Head
formats.description: Silences removed automatically, punch-in zoom on every other cut, karaoke captions.

formats.name: Podcast Clip (2 Speakers)
formats.description: Two speakers stacked top/bottom (or active speaker full) with karaoke captions on the seam.

formats.name: Audiogram
formats.description: Audio-only clip with cover art, waveform and captions.

formats.name: Founder Story
formats.description: Founder to camera ('I built this because…') with b-roll cutaways and karaoke captions.
structure: talking head with b-roll inserts at marked times

formats.name: Yapper Hot Take
formats.description: Fast, opinionated rant to camera; big emphasis words, punch zooms.
structure: 0-end: face, karaoke with emphasised words, zoom punches

formats.name: Vanity-Mirror Interview
formats.description: Host interviews a guest at a vanity mirror about dating/lifestyle; question caption + captions.

formats.name: Street Interview
formats.description: Mic-in-hand question to strangers; question as top caption, answers captioned, product as the twist.

formats.name: Don't Watch If…
formats.description: Opens by telling the wrong viewers to leave ('if you're in a relationship, scroll'), then pitches.

formats.name: Expert + B-Roll Explainer
formats.description: Expert talking head interleaved with full-screen b-roll while the voice continues (J/L cuts).

formats.name: Answering a Comment
formats.description: Comment-reply sticker over the creator answering it.
structure: 0-end: talking head + comment sticker for first 3-5s + karaoke

formats.name: Walk and Talk
formats.description: Selfie walking vlog with captions; light b-roll inserts.

formats.name: Car Talk
formats.description: Parked-car confessional, hook title then karaoke captions.

formats.name: Faceless TTS Explainer
formats.description: Script → TTS voice over stock/b-roll/screen clips with karaoke captions; no creator needed.

formats.name: Storytime
formats.description: Creator storytime with a title card and chapter-like captions at story beats.

formats.name: Benchmark Education
formats.description: 'The average household spends $X on…' stat card then creator explains and demos the tool.

formats.name: Hook Variants (Batch)
formats.description: Same body clip with N different hook intros, rendered as separate reels for A/B testing.

example_reference.description: Standard ad-testing practice (many hooks, one body).

formats.name: Before → After
formats.description: Before clip with 'before' label, hard cut (on the beat) to after with 'after' label; optional process middle.

example_reference.description: 'Before and After' is a top-10 hit-rate format (Motion 2026).

formats.name: Slider Wipe Reveal
formats.description: Before and after layered; a wipe line slides across revealing the after.

example_reference.description: Split-screen before/after: 65% completion in 2026 creator analytics (eliro/others).

formats.name: Glow-Up on the Drop
formats.description: Before held until the music drop, then hard cut/flash to after.

formats.name: Day 1 vs Day 30
formats.description: Progress over time with day counter ticking between snapshots.

example_reference.description: 'I tested X for 30 days' testimonial structure.

formats.name: Expectation vs Reality
formats.description: Split: expectation top, reality bottom (or sequential), labels.

formats.name: Makeover Timelapse
formats.description: Fixed-camera timelapse of a transformation with before/after bookends.

formats.name: AI Transformation
formats.description: Photo before → app processing state → transformed result, with visible tool UI (Facetune-style).

example_reference.description: Facetune 'meme plus feature proof' (Lightreel); AI Style Transfer 72% completion (2026 analytics).

formats.name: Old Way vs New Way
formats.description: Old painful workflow (grayscale, sped up, frustrated) vs new way with the app (colour, fast).

formats.name: Progress Grid
formats.description: Grid of progress photos filling chronologically, final cell enlarges.
structure: last tile zooms to full screen

formats.name: Payoff Result
formats.description: Big money counter from debt to zero, then feature demo.

formats.name: Photo-Mode Slideshow
formats.description: TikTok photo-carousel look as a video: 4-8 full-screen images with tiktok-box text, one per 2-3s, problem→payoff story.

example_reference.description: Carousels get ~1.9x likes / 2.6x shares vs video per TikTok data (virlo, posteverywhere 2026 guides).

formats.name: Problem → Proof → Product
formats.description: Three-slide story: the problem, the visible proof the solution works, the product name.

formats.name: Aesthetic Photo Dump
formats.description: Fast photo dump cut on the beat with a single caption.

formats.name: Ken Burns Story
formats.description: Slow pan/zoom across photos with narrative captions (or TTS).

formats.name: App Screenshot Carousel
formats.description: App screenshots (in phone frame) one per slide with benefit captions.
structure: per screenshot: phone frame + benefit caption

example_reference.description: App store screenshots repurposed as content.

formats.name: Quote Cards
formats.description: Quote text slides over moody backgrounds.

formats.name: Moodboard Build
formats.description: Images drop into a collage one by one forming a moodboard.

formats.name: Then vs Now Slides
formats.description: Paired slides: then (grayscale) / now (colour) per topic.

formats.name: Slideshow + Voiceover
formats.description: Slides timed to a voiceover (recorded or TTS) with karaoke captions.

formats.name: Static-to-Video
formats.description: A static ad image brought to life: subtle zoom, text pops in sequence, CTA.

formats.name: Meme Top Bar
formats.description: Classic white bar with black text above a reaction clip; clip scaled into the lower area.
structure: 0-end: white top panel with text, clip below

formats.name: Nobody: / Me:
formats.description: 'Nobody: / Me:' setup text over an absurd clip.

formats.name: Me Explaining to…
formats.description: 'Me explaining to my mom why I need this app' over a passionate-explaining clip.

formats.name: Meme + Feature Proof
formats.description: Topical joke becomes a visible transformation using the app (shows tool + processing).

formats.name: Two-Panel Preference
formats.description: Two stacked panels: reject (top) vs approve (bottom) reaction clips with labels.

example_reference.description: Preference meme structure (use own footage, not copyrighted stills).

formats.name: When You…
formats.description: 'When you finally…' relatable caption over a reaction clip.

formats.name: Escalating Levels
formats.description: Levels 1-4 of increasingly galaxy-brain solutions, final is your app.
structure: 4 stacked panels revealing one by one

formats.name: That One Friend
formats.description: 'That one friend who…' skit-lite with a caption.

formats.name: Punchline Cut
formats.description: Setup clip, then a hard cut to a still image punchline with a sound sting.

formats.name: What They Think vs Reality
formats.description: 'What my friends think I do / what I actually do' stacked labels.

formats.name: Pattern Interrupt
formats.description: A deliberately weird first frame (odd zoom, upside-down, glitch) then the actual message.

formats.name: UGC Testimonial
formats.description: Creator's personal result story to camera with karaoke captions, product shots, CTA end card.

formats.name: Unboxing Reveal
formats.description: Package open → product reveal → first use; ASMR sound kept.

formats.name: Offer-First Banner
formats.description: A persistent offer banner ('50% off this week') from frame one over UGC footage.
structure: persistent offer banner in band top

formats.name: Problem → Agitate → Solve
formats.description: Three acts: name the pain, twist the knife, product solves it; each act its own clip/caption.

formats.name: Us vs Them
formats.description: Comparison table/checklist: competitor column with X marks, yours with checks, or split footage.

formats.name: 3 Reasons Why
formats.description: '3 reasons I switched to X' numbered reasons, each with a proof clip.

formats.name: I Tested It for 30 Days
formats.description: Day-stamped clips through a trial period ending in the result.

example_reference.description: 'I tested [product] for 30 days' — top UGC testimonial pattern 2026.

formats.name: Genuine First Use
formats.description: Creator uses the app for the first time on camera and reacts in real time; screen PiP.
